## Language Policy (Mandatory)

English is the only language permitted in the repository.

### General rules

- All source code must be written in English.
- All identifiers (variables, functions, classes, methods, modules, constants, enums, database models, migrations, etc.) must use English names.
- All comments must be written in English.
- All docstrings must be written in English.
- All log messages must be written in English.
- All exception and error messages must be written in English.
- All API responses, validation messages, and server-side messages must be written in English.
- All unit tests, integration tests, feature files, fixtures, and test descriptions must be written in English.
- All commit messages must be written in English.
- All pull request titles and descriptions must be written in English.
- All issue titles and descriptions created by Codex must be written in English.
- All Markdown documentation must be written in English.
- All configuration comments must be written in English.
- All Docker, CI/CD, and infrastructure comments must be written in English.

### Existing code

- Do not introduce new Spanish text anywhere in the repository.
- When modifying existing files containing Spanish technical text, translate that text to English if it is within the scope of the change.
- Prefer improving existing English rather than introducing mixed-language files.
- Avoid leaving files partially translated.

### Exceptions

The following content must never be translated automatically unless explicitly requested:

- User-generated content.
- Photo names.
- Album names.
- Folder names created by users.
- User tags.
- Locations and place names supplied by users.
- Personal notes.
- Imported metadata.
- Database contents originating from users.

### Naming

- Follow the existing project naming conventions.
- Use English for every new identifier.
- Avoid abbreviations unless they are industry standard.
- Prefer descriptive names over shortened names.

### User Interface

- The entire user interface must be written in English.
- README.md must be written in English.
- Documentation under `/docs` must be written in English.
- Configuration examples must use English.
- Future documentation must be written only in English.

### Reviews

Before considering a task complete, verify that:

- No new Spanish text has been introduced.
- No mixed-language comments exist.
- All newly added documentation is in English.
- All new identifiers use English.
- All new user-facing messages are in English.
